<thought>We need more structural clues. The proton spectrum shows 7 H with patterns suggesting a methyl coupled to a methine, and a vinyl CH2 (2H) coupled trans to a vinyl CH (1H). The methine (4.43 ppm) is coupled to the methyl (4.2 Hz) and to the vinyl CH (8.0 Hz). This pattern is consistent with a 2‑methyl‑1‑butenyl fragment (CH₃‑CH‑CH₂‑CH=). To confirm the carbon environment and overall formula, we should obtain the 13C NMR spectrum.</thought>
